msg: Hey! I got my Open Water certification 3 years ago but haven't dived since. I'm staying in Getsemaní for a week and would love to dive on two different days. What would you recommend and how much is it? Can I pay cash in dollars on the boat?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands! Since it’s been 3 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required before fun dives.

Both are day trips from Cartagena, with boat transport and lunch included. The online discount is 10% and is applied automatically when booking on the website.

Payment is made through the online booking link. International clients pay 100% by card on the website; the 50% deposit option is only for Colombians and residents of Colombia. I don’t have a specific confirmation about paying cash in dollars on the boat, but nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD (150.000 COP · 167.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. I'm German by the way. So what's the plan, the refresher on day one and normal dives on day two? Does the refresher day include lunch too?
reply:
Yes, that’s a good plan: do the refresher on day one, then regular fun dives on day two. The refresher includes pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor, plus lunch. It also includes the boat transfer, equipment, mandatory dive insurance, National Park entrance fee, and an eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.

The meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. The boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival at 4:15 p.m.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
